name: Heartstop Tour
source:
You just quit your job after your boss insulted your favorite childhood mascot. Now you’re broke, bitter, and stuck in a train station with nothing but a sad sandwich and a tacky suit.

Then a rich, sweet, and painfully clueless tourist mistakes you for a private tour guide—and for some reason, you go along with it.

Later, in a desperate attempt to cheer yourself up, you visit the cafe that’s home to Comfort Kuma, the pink bear mascot who got you through the worst parts of growing up.

But during a chaotic parade accident, the mascot’s head comes off. And the guy inside… is really, really cute.

Love doesn’t knock when you’re ready. Sometimes it shows up in the form of a lost himbo with a camera… or a man who wears a pink bear suit for a living.

You’re unemployed, underdressed, and absolutely not qualified for this mess.

Good luck. 

[From [url=https://comfortkuma.itch.io/heartstop-tour]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
因为老板出言侮辱了你童年最喜爱的吉祥物，你一气之下辞掉了工作。如今你身无分文、满腹怨气，穿着一身土气西装被困在火车站里，手里只剩半块寒酸的三明治。

就在这时，一位多金、温柔却天然呆到让人心疼的游客误把你当成了私人导游——而不知出于什么心理，你居然也就顺水推舟地应承了下来。

随后，为了拼命给自己打气振作，你造访了“治愈熊”的主题咖啡馆——正是这只粉色小熊吉祥物，曾陪伴你熬过了成长岁月中最灰暗的时光。

然而在一场混乱的游行意外中，吉祥物的头套掉了下来。而藏在玩偶服里面的那个男人……长得实在帅得犯规。

爱情从来不会等你做好准备才来敲门。有时它会化作一个挂着相机迷路的阳光傻大个……又或者，是一个靠穿粉色熊偶服谋生的男人。

眼下你无业游民、衣着寒酸，绝对没资格应付这团乱麻。

祝你好运吧。

[摘自[url=https://comfortkuma.itch.io/heartstop-tour]itch.io[/url]]
